units.source_text: 又过了两三天，我终于下决心自杀，

en.t: After another two or three days, I finally resolved to kill myself,

units.source_text: 正如我不理解乃木先生为什么自杀一样，也许你也不会真正理解我自杀的道理。

en.t: just as I do not understand why General Nogi killed himself, perhaps you too will not truly understand my reason for doing so.

units.source_text: 倘若如此，便是由时代变迁造成的人与人的差异，亦是无可奈何。

en.t: If that is so, it is a difference between people caused by the changing times, and there is nothing to be done about it.

units.source_text: 或许说成是个人的天性不同更确切些吧。

en.t: Or perhaps it would be more accurate to call it a difference in each person's inborn nature.

units.source_text: 总之，为了让你能够理解我这个不可思议的人，我已经尽我所能把一切都告诉你了。

en.t: In any case, so that you might understand this incomprehensible person that I am, I have told you everything as fully as I can.
I am going away, leaving my wife behind.

units.source_text: 幸运的是，我死之后，妻子也不会生活无着。

en.t: Fortunately, after I die, my wife will not be left without the means to live.

units.source_text: 我不想让她经受恐怖的惊吓，

en.t: I do not want to make her suffer a terrible shock,

units.source_text: 不想让她目睹死亡的血腥。

en.t: nor do I want her to witness the bloodiness of death.

units.source_text: 为此，我打算在她不知道的时候，悄然离开这个世界。

en.t: For that reason, I intend to leave this world quietly at a time when she does not know.

units.source_text: 我希望她以为我是突然死亡的，

en.t: I hope she will think I died suddenly,

units.source_text: 哪怕她认为我疯了，我也心满意足。

en.t: and even if she thinks I went mad, I will be content.
